intro.title: Acme **Reports**
intro.sub: See your weekly numbers in one place.

items.v: So nobody can answer: are we growing?

beats.say: This is Acme Reports. One page that shows how your business is really doing.
Today your numbers live in five different tools, and none of them answers the simple question. Are we growing?
Let's start with the overview tab. At the top are the four numbers that matter this week.
Scroll down and you get the trend, with every point you can hover over.
Wide tables scroll sideways, so nothing is hidden.
That's Acme Reports. One page, every Monday.
